work.author: Congregation for Catholic Education and Congregation for the Clergy
work.description: Two documents of 22 February 1998 published together: the Basic Norms for the Formation of Permanent Deacons (Congregation for Catholic Education) and the Directory for the Ministry and Life of Permanent Deacons (Congregation for the Clergy), with a joint declaration stating that the Directory has juridically binding force where it recalls disciplinary norms of the Code or determines the manner of applying universal laws, and is then to be regarded as a formal general executory decree under CIC c. 32.
work.title: Basic Norms for the Formation of Permanent Deacons; Directory for the Ministry and Life of Permanent Deacons
